parameter.def: An extra input variable, often written t, that both coordinates of a curve depend on. Each value of the parameter picks out one point, and increasing it sets the order in which the points are traced.

parametric.def: A function f(t) = (x(t), y(t)) that sends each value of a parameter t to the point (x(t), y(t)). As t runs through an interval, the points trace a curve with a direction of travel.
